proposed_facts.reason: Canonical declarations contain three populated callback records, a zero record and a separate referencing descriptor. Removing compiled-placement assertions is appropriate.
The static pointer has no explicit initializer; its four UNK_T fields are returned as DynamicsDesc pointers for the stated surface kinds. Small-data placement remains unproven.
Load is empty, initialization performs setup, and start separately calls the common generator creator. The correction avoids equating that call with target creation.

The caller discards the result and passes NULL to a SpawnDesc pointer parameter. The callee explicitly frees data on GObj creation failure and publishes configuration/data after scheduling on success.
Start makes an unconditional creation request with null spawn-description configuration, not an owner object, and performs no success check or local spawning logic.
Object 1's Callback3 occupies the fourth function position and its canonical body is empty.

The explicit rejection paths return NULL; recognized joint-0 surface paths dereference the cached pointer without validation. The proposed lifetime and aliasing qualifications correctly avoid stronger guarantees.

The helper indexes and retrieves by the same unchecked ID. The canonical inline confirms callback clearing, GX linking, conditional callback3 storage, initialization and priority-4 processing, without consuming callback1 or flags.
